subject.title: [Feature Request] Auto-linkify URLs in tool output cards (Control UI & WebChat)

question: Should this issue require both Control UI and native WebChat URL linkification before it can close, or should native parity be split from the Control UI repair?
rationale: The Control UI fix shape is bounded, but the issue title/body also name native WebChat; automation should not decide whether a web-only implementation satisfies the broader user request.

options.title: Narrow to Control UI first
options.body: Implement and prove the complete Control UI tool-output behavior now, then track native WebChat parity separately if maintainers still want it.

options.title: Require full parity
options.body: Keep this issue open until both Control UI and native OpenClawChatUI render safe clickable URL links in tool output.

options.title: Make native out of scope
options.body: Document that native WebChat is not part of this issue and close only after the Control UI behavior is implemented and proven.

recommendation.title: Narrow to Control UI first
recommendation.body: Implement and prove the complete Control UI tool-output behavior now, then track native WebChat parity separately if maintainers still want it.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already made the prior scope call on this issue and merged the current-main UI/native chat surface history.
